item.title: Tyrone claim first Division 2 victory while Cork make it three wins out of three
item.description: Tyrone got their first win of the Allianz Football League Division 2 campaign by inflicting Cavan's third successive loss (2-23 to 1-14) in Omagh this afternoon.

item.title: O'Donnell goal helps Donegal see off Mayo for third successive win in Division 1
item.description: Donegal moved two points clear at the top of the Allianz Football League Division 1 table thanks to a convincing 1-19 to 0-14 victory over Mayo in Letterkenny this afternoon.

item.title: Rossies defeat Orchard men for back-to-back wins in Division 1
item.description: Roscommon's goals proved vital as they picked up their second win in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League at Armagh's expense this afternoon.

item.title: Sunday's Allianz Football League results and tables
item.description: Here are this afternoon's Allianz Football League third round results...

item.title: Moran takes positives from defeat
item.description: Andy Moran was accentuating the positives after suffering his first defeat in the Allianz Football League as Mayo manager.

item.title: Cleary plays down winning start
item.description: John Cleary reckons the toughest is yet to come for his high-flying Cork side after they maintained their 100% record in Division 2 of the Allianz Football League with a comfortable victory over Offaly.

item.title: Galligan follows Graham to Galway
item.description: Galway football boss Padraic Joyce has added Raymond Galligan to his backroom team.

item.title: 'If we breached, we breached'
item.description: Armagh manager Kieran McGeeney wasn't making an issue of a breach call which cost his side dearly for the second game in-a-row.

item.title: 'There is a good bit to work on'
item.description: Jim McGuinness wasn't getting carried away after Donegal maintained their perfect record in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League with a comfortable victory over Mayo.

item.title: Oz-bound Canavan to miss League run-in
item.description: Tyrone will be without Darragh Canavan for the latter stages of the Allianz Football League.
